info.title: SALES DIRECTOR DEALERSHIPS (M/F/D)
info.jobDescription:
GTM STRATEGY FOR GOLF CARTS & LSV VEHICLES
As the Sales Director of Dealerships, you will play a critical role in driving the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for golf carts and LSV (Low-Speed Vehicle) sales within NIU Technologies’ Dealer Network across the US. Your primary focus will be on building, expanding, and optimizing sales channels through dealership partnerships, ensuring long-term growth and profitability. This role requires a strategic mindset to execute market entry, develop scalable sales models, and align with our broader business
objectives.

info.title: KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER (M/F/D)
info.jobDescription:
DEALERSHIPS & FLAGSHIPS - MID-WEST USA
As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining key accounts for NIU Technologies in the Flagship Store and Dealer network for our Micro-Mobility line of kick-scooters and E-bikes as well as our DOT and off-road line of mopeds, motorcycles and off-road vehicles. You will also be responsible for business growth opportunities with other product categories in your channel.
